name: Kinetic Type
tagline: Hand-drawn cel energy: a word that bursts, plays and gets eaten by lightning.
description: Frame-by-frame logotype animation on a grainy black ground: three inks (chalk, signal yellow, ultramarine), brushy dry-edged strokes, a hyperspace burst that becomes the word's arrival, letters snapped together from shape debris, one glyph that never stops playing, and a lightning stroke that eats it all. Animated on twos.
avoidFor: corporate, finance or medical trust stories

display.fallback: "Cooper Black", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif

signature: radial hyperspace burst: streaks rush out of a lens-star and the zoom-through becomes the word's arrival
shape-debris assembly: diamonds, blocks and sparks fly in and snap into glyphs with a squash
stroke wipe: a speed line slices the word, a zig-zag lightning eats it, one four-point star twinkles out

camera: Flat and locked: the 'camera' is drawn — radial streaks fake a zoom-through, hold frames shake by a pixel of boil; no real 3D camera moves.

texture.notes: Fine film grain re-seeded every drawing, dry broken brush edges via displacement that boils on twos, a faint vignette. No gradients except the star's glow.

lighting: Graphic, not lit: the only light is the lens-star twinkle and its soft chalk glow; everything else is flat ink on black.
sound: Cartoon foley on the drawings: a rising whoosh into the burst, a stack of pops and ticks as debris lands, a tiny boing per squash, a crackle-zap for the lightning, a sparkle ting on the last star.

beats.label: Hyperspace burst, debris snaps into kazoo
The o plays; lightning eats the word
One star drifts home into the scribble

motionSummary: Moves like cel animation on twos: a scribble pops into a star, the star bursts into hyperspace, debris snaps into the word, one letter never stops playing, lightning eats it all.

composition: one heavy lowercase word centred and huge, alone on the black sky
bursts fill the frame edge to edge; holds shrink back to the word plus 2–4 sparks
no layout grid: the word's own slots are the grid; debris and sparks orbit it
visual.shapeLanguage: drawn shapes with dry brush edges: four-point lens stars, diamonds, square tiles, spirals, zig-zags, scribble circles
visual.contrast: maximum: chalk, signal yellow and ultramarine flat inks on grainy near-black; yellow is energy, ultramarine its shadow

grammar.pacing: bursts then living holds: 0.6–1.3 s of chaos, 1.3–2 s of a word that fidgets; one word per beat
grammar.rhythm: on twos (every drawing held 2 frames), snaps land on even frames and on the beat; boil never stops
grammar.easing: snap-in with overshoot (enter y > 1), anticipation before exits (exit dips below 0), stepped substitutions (steps:3)
grammar.acceleration: explosive starts, no slow-in: things arrive in 2–4 drawings and squash; exits wind up for one drawing then leave in 2–3
movement: radial hyperspace burst from a lens-star
debris flying in and snapping into glyphs
squash and stretch on every landing
one glyph cycling substitutions while the rest holds
speed-line slice and zig-zag lightning eating the word
a four-point star twinkling and drifting
grammar.density: extremes: 20–40 drawn elements during a burst, 1 word + 1 playing glyph + 2–4 sparks during a hold
grammar.holds: a hold is never still: boil ±1.5 px per drawing, one glyph plays, sparks pop on the beat

transitionPresets.name: Hyperspace burst
transitionPresets.build: the star flares for 2 drawings, then radial brush streaks (three inks + grey) rush outward, growing longer and thicker with distance; density peaks, then thins as the next scene's debris arrives through it
transitionPresets.sound: rising whoosh, a pop on the flare

transitionPresets.name: Debris snap
transitionPresets.bridge: the burst's own shapes (diamonds, blocks, sparks)
transitionPresets.build: each shape flies to a letter slot with a 2-frame stagger, the shape is replaced by the glyph on landing and the glyph squashes 1.28/0.70 → 0.90/1.14 → 1.04/0.97 → 1 over three drawings
transitionPresets.sound: a stack of pops and ticks, one boing per squash

transitionPresets.name: Shape match
transitionPresets.bridge: a round (or square) shape shared by both scenes
transitionPresets.build: on one drawing the shape swaps identity: scribble circle → star → the 'o'; tile → letter → spiral; the rest of the frame changes around it

transitionPresets.name: Impact frame
transitionPresets.build: one drawing (2 frames) of the whole frame in yellow with the outgoing word knocked out in ultramarine, then the next word is already there, mid-squash
transitionPresets.sound: a hard hit on the downbeat

transitionPresets.name: Stroke wipe (lightning)
transitionPresets.bridge: a speed line and a zig-zag lightning stroke
transitionPresets.build: a yellow speed line slices the word left → right (4 drawings), then a zig-zag lightning with an ultramarine echo sweeps across; the word is clipped away behind the bolt's tail

transitionPresets.name: Star carry
transitionPresets.build: the one star left after an exit twinkles, then drifts on a short arc to where the next mark (or the opening scribble) will be drawn around it

archetypes.name: Hyperspace arrival
archetypes.purpose: open with energy: the thing is born from a burst
archetypes.composition: a boiling scribble circle or lens-star at frame centre on black, then radial streaks edge to edge
archetypes.elements: scribble circle, lens-star with soft chalk glow, 24–40 radial brush streaks in three inks + grey
archetypes.motion: circle collapses into the star (10 f), star flares, streaks rush outward on twos
archetypes.camera: drawn zoom-through (streak length = speed); the frame never moves

archetypes.name: Debris assembly
archetypes.purpose: build the word or logo out of scraps
archetypes.composition: letter slots across the centre; debris converging from all edges
archetypes.elements: diamonds, blocks and sparks that become glyphs; heavy rounded lowercase letters
archetypes.motion: 2-frame stagger per letter, squash on landing, small sparks pop off each snap

archetypes.name: Living hold
archetypes.purpose: let the word be read and give it a personality
archetypes.composition: the word centred and huge, 2–4 sparks around it, one glyph is the playground
archetypes.elements: the playing glyph cycles: yellow tilted tile with the letter knocked out → spiral → four-point star → ultramarine blob
archetypes.motion: a substitution every 6 f (steps:3), boil on every drawing, sparks twinkle on the beat

archetypes.name: Word swap on the beat
archetypes.purpose: say a short line one word at a time
archetypes.composition: one word per beat, centred; the shared round letter stays in place across words
archetypes.elements: 2–4 short words; the round glyph is the anchor that never leaves
archetypes.motion: each word snaps in mid-squash; between words an impact frame or a shape match on the round glyph

archetypes.name: Lightning sign-off
archetypes.purpose: leave with a bang and a twinkle
archetypes.composition: the word mid-frame, a speed line across its x-height, then an empty black frame with one star
archetypes.elements: speed line, zig-zag lightning with ultramarine echo, the last four-point star
archetypes.motion: slice → bolt eats the word left → right → the star twinkles out or carries on

beats.purpose: a spark of energy before anything is said
the first word arrives and shows its personality
beats.motion: debris snaps into the word; one glyph starts playing

beats.purpose: the line, word by word on the beat
beats.motion: words snap in on downbeats; the round glyph carries across

beats.purpose: the name, built big and alive
beats.motion: a second burst; the wordmark assembles and holds, playing
lightning eats the word; one star twinkles

sequence.cutRhythm: bursts then holds; every change lands on an even frame and on the beat; impact frames are 1 drawing; no fades, no soft cuts

scenes.action: a chalk scribble circle boils, collapses into a lens-star, the star blows open into a hyperspace burst
diamonds and blocks fly out of the streaks and snap into 'make', each letter squashing; the 'a' starts flipping to a yellow tile
yellow impact frame on the downbeat; 'some' snaps in, then 'noise', the 'o' held in place as the shared shape
the 'o' becomes the 'o' of 'kazoo', the rest of the wordmark snaps around it; the second 'o' cycles tile → spiral → star → blob, sparks pop
a speed line slices 'kazoo', lightning eats it left → right, one star twinkles and drifts to centre

elements.text: heavy rounded lowercase, one word at a time; letters snap in from debris with a squash and boil on every drawing; leave by being eaten by a stroke, never by fading
elements.logo: assembled from debris; one glyph of it keeps playing during the hold; signs off with lightning and a single star
elements.icons: only as drawn shapes (stars, tiles, spirals, blobs) that double as glyph substitutions
elements.images: none; if a product must appear, as a flat ink drawing or a silhouette knocked out of a yellow tile
elements.ui: avoid; if needed, redraw a UI element as a flat ink shape that bursts or gets eaten like a word
elements.shapes: four-point stars, diamonds, square tiles, spirals, zig-zags, scribble circles; all with dry brush edges and boil
elements.background: grainy near-black with a faint vignette; grain re-seeded every drawing; never a colour field except the 1-drawing impact frame
elements.particles: drawn sparks and debris only: they arrive with bursts, pop on beats during holds, and become letters

audio.sync: snaps, impact frames and word swaps on downbeats; the burst rides a riser into the drop; the lightning lands on the last hit; sparks on hi-hats
audio.sfx: rising whoosh, pops and ticks per debris, boing per squash, crackle-zap, sparkle ting
